notes: Head is treated as a leaf since it protrudes on a distinct neck (reptile). Tail is a single leaf. Each leg is one leaf pair; single joint (elbow/knee) inferred midway between shoulder/hip and foot based on the bend visible in the XY profile and the lateral splay visible in the XZ top view. Left/right assigned by z-value (smaller z = _L, larger z = _R) per animal's own frame; this is an arbitrary but consistent convention since exact facing chirality isn't determinable from silhouettes alone. Root 'pelvis' chosen as central spine hub; spine_front (shoulder girdle) and tail_base are separate spine segments so the body is a multi-node spine, not a single hub. All leg z-splay values taken from the XZ (top) panel where front and hind legs both fan to about z=6-8 and z=16-18 from a central spine at z=12; the ZY (front) panel corroborates the overall body width. Screen-down positive-y coordinates were flipped in sign (dy = -(child_y - parent_y)) for every node so descending limbs get negative dy, verified on hind leg (knee->foot direction dy=-3, correctly negative).
